caption: The video captures a nighttime beach scene with a large fireworks burst occupying the upper-center sky above dark water and a distant city skyline. Its gold and orange crown caps a magenta-purple core, while bright sparks spread radially from a nearly fixed center. Additional golden bursts merge into the middle, and the core grows into a bright white-yellow mass. The glow casts shifting golden reflections on the water and brightens silhouetted spectators. After the peak, the central glow softens and outer streaks resolve into purple and blue droplet-like stars. Those stars hang and drift slowly downward as smoke accumulates near the left side of the burst and along the horizon. A blurred foreground head enters from the bottom edge and shifts across the lower frame. The standing couple, city lights, and horizon remain fixed while the fireworks continue expanding and fading.
